name: Bumi (Defensive dips + calm-market QQQ)
note: Runs through app/bumi_run.py when STRATEGY=bumi, not through BRAINS. BUMI_MODE=paper sends orders; anything else is shadow. Rules from plans/snap-research.md and plans/defensive-tests.md. Backtest reference: run #77. Stops are checked after the close and sold at the next open; never use a resting stop.

risk.note: Live-phase checks (2026-11-26), measured on the money Bumi trades (BUMI_SIZE_FRACTION of the account). bad_day: pauses NEW buys until /resume-bumi (never happened since 2001). drawdown: alert only, Bumi keeps trading (about once every 5 years in the backtest). Bumi never sells because of either.
